resource_check.offline_resource_clearance_scope: independent local/WSL lock and peer workload clearance

candidate_identity.source_binding: clean native Git checkout; executable hash, not a build attestation

policy: ordinary exit and exact UTF-8 stdout/stderr bytes for valid Unicode scalar argv; Windows CRLF, LF elsewhere; no normalization

stream_contract.newlines: Windows CRLF; LF on other platforms

limitation: Help and valid Unicode-scalar unknown dispatch with UTF-8 stdout/stderr only; Windows CRLF is preserved. Locale/default and other output encodings, version/runtime identity, non-UTF-8 or surrogate argv and other mode contracts remain deferred.
